name: Web Lurker Deadfall
disable: Survival (trained) or Thievery (expert) DC 20 to rearrange the webbing.

items.name: Deadfall
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps into the square with the web tripwire.

---

Effect All creatures in the trap's 10-foot square take 2d6 bludgeoning damage (DC 20 basic Reflex save save).

text: A web tripwire lets loose a bundle of boulders that fall on all targets within a 10-foot square.
